headline: "Foreigners Left Despite Semiconductor Boom"… Samsung Electronics Foreign Ownership Lowest Since 2008
summary: Foreign ownership of Samsung Electronics has dropped to levels last seen during the 2008 financial crisis. SK Hynix foreign ownership has been below 50% since the end of last month, after exceeding half since 2023.
why: Samsung Electronics is South Korea's largest company and a major memory chip maker. Shifts in foreign shareholding can signal changing global investor positioning in Korean chip stocks.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Falling foreign ownership reflects reduced overseas investor stakes in the company's shares.
